status: Scientific labels: CANDIDATE_UNVERIFIED, CORRECTNESS_ACCEPTED_SCOPED_PARTIAL, OPEN, UNKNOWN, or GATE_MET only with all applicable frozen gates. Partial claims require their own exact-scope evidence and parent verdict; they do not automatically meet every full-target gate. Run execution status is separate and never certifies science. README is navigation; immutable verdict/receipts are authority.

independent_review.verdict: GO-WITHIN-INITIAL-SCOPE; material launch-boundary recommendations disposed separately

preservation_and_inputs.rule: Before use, hash every load-bearing prior regular file against its controlling record; missing/mismatched is INHERITED_UNAVAILABLE, not silently repaired. Never open old FIFO/socket or follow symlinks while scanning. No hardlinks or writable symlinks to old evidence. Old code must run with bytecode/cache/output paths contained in the new lane. Full old corpus hashing is not an admission prerequisite; no claim of full-corpus preservation audit.

small_probes: Worker-authored source frozen before execution, <=300s self wall-budget checked during work; explicit tool timeout0. Third-party/downloaded code is data until explicitGO. No runtime deadline tool may kill the process.

chunk_fit.rule: Before every launch freeze absolute wall-clock child end <= min(now+max_chunk_seconds-120, owned_compute_settled_by-180). No launch whose worst-case child budget plus120s settlement and60s margin cannot fit. Check absolute cutoff as well as elapsed clock after sleep/resume. At owned_compute_settled_by-120 parent requests ownedSIGTERM for registered survivors; no escalation.
chunk_fit.scope: All busy components/descendants count; RSS is whole-lane total. UNSETTLED anywhere blocks all new scientific launches until disposition.

ownership: Every job has exclusive parent-readable launch record: item, owner, parentGO hash, PID/PGID, launch/start identity, argv/source/binary/input pins, cwd, absolute child end, output paths and retained-byte reservation. Send parent exact path immediately. Parent may identity-check and SIGTERM any registered owned job; responsibility transfers on worker end/kernel loss. Unregistered or identity-mismatched processes are never signalled by inference.
settled_definition: Recorded direct-child exit/signal reaped, owned descendant census clear, output streams closed and named final artifacts pinned, final receipt/checkpoint written. If any condition cannot be observed, report UNSETTLED/UNKNOWN; no PASS or implicit completion.
stops: Each itemGO cites parent-reviewed lane STOP-registry path/hash and dispositions of every relevant inherited/new stop. Only parent supersedes a stop through a NEW versionedGO; markers stay untouched. Safety/correctness notices immediately latch STOP on the affected item; memory/disk/systemwide notices block all scientific launches until parent disposition. Disk-stopped output is UNKNOWN unless independent completeness evidence qualifies it; old accepted receipts are not demoted merely because another attempt failed.
resource_reservations: Each GO freezes retained output byte reservation and enforcement (byte-capped sink/log cap or proven fixed-size output bound), in-flight disk/RSS sampling cadence, and ownedSIGTERM on overrun. Before admission, freshfree minus sum remaining admitted retained-output reservations must remain >=12e9. Account new per-lane10GiB and parent10GiB ceilings; streams held only inRAM are charged to RSS, not falsely to disk. Shared observer is metadata, not an enforcement guard. Guard unreadability or underestimated unbounded output holds admission.
proof_transport: For streamed proofs require contemporaneous producer-read and checker-delivered bytecounts/SHA256, checker-consumed bytecount equality, formula/binary/argv binding, and every pipeline exit/signal. Checker-consumed bytes do not imply a separately measured consumer SHA; state actual measured boundaries. Same checker-binary positive/intended-reason mutation controls mandatory. Parent independently audits the measured endpoints; rereplay only newly required or specifically defective inputs, never backfill old digests. Streamed payload non-retention and shared checker trust stay explicit.
slots: Two owned problem slots per area are maintained. A slot may be blocked/idle with explicit reason; do not manufacture work or start a third target. Replacement requires parent frozen transition and a new primary-status/claim contract. Original outcome remains unchanged.

closeout.rule: Assemble draft before freeze; include every launch with finalstate or explicitUNSETTLED, precise scientific boundary, named-input recheck and deviations. Incomplete review means CANDIDATE, not silent gate promotion. Final report independent review required.

prior_short_qualification: StageA terminalqualification completed before this addendum under its frozen itemGO; all children settled within~seconds and measured guard/terminal controls passed. Do not describe this addendum as preregistered for that completed attempt.
